architecture_block: Frozen inputs and persistent bounded jobs
objective: Implement approved S2a frozen file inputs and explicit new-target state migration at BASE b30b1979cfc5edefd2291fb516f4c9d38a64597d; S2b separately adds the persistent queue, bounded worker and recovery. Preserve pre-S1 modes and the ar.shared-workspace.v1 API while fencing S1 with a distinct storage schema.
non_goals: No S3 automatic synchronization or S4 full/integrated/browser/two-device gates in S2a.
No production, in-use service or state, ACL, member, network, provider, paid, market or registry calls.
No subagents, reviewer spawn, ledger edits, install, push or merge.
dependencies: Approved task-2a-brief.md including Controller Scope Ruling
S2a fix round 1 at BASE 42f308ec6e02825cbf82313bb9371e8ba9d24dd4: resolve approved review R1-R4 together using the supplied historical compatibility shapes; no production import
forbidden_scope: All files outside the bounded slice
input_contracts: S2a FrozenInputs.import_once/verify reuse PUBLIC/BUNDLE whitelist, no-follow bounded reads and boundary validation; preserve originals and safe attempt projection; bind registry, seal and content hashes without poll time.

S2a backup_shared/restore_shared use SQLite backup API, fixed table counts/event tail, integrity and artifact checks; omit cookie, allowlist and owner credentials. migrate_legacy uses only a verified backup and a new target, immutable historical bytes, STOP/interrupted/orphan accounting and source-hash-bound crash convergence.

R1-R2: support the actual publisher manifest and explicitly known historical variants; required core versus optional legacy aliases; absent intrinsic identity remains absent and has explicit cryptographic publication-context provenance. Present contradictions, missing declared artifacts and unsafe paths remain refused; no producer or legacy renderer changes.

R3-R4: limited old exports cannot establish complete migration; require complete backup_shared reconciliation. Atomic durable file publish from bound staging, preserve incomplete evidence, retry the same uncommitted work after creation/during write/before publish, and refuse existing committed corruption.

Controller ruling permits nonprod_workbench.py only for shared SQLite schema guard/init and tests/workbench_shared_test_support.py only for state fixtures. S1 binary must reject the new storage schema, no silent upgrade.

S2b requests contain command_id/kind/snapshot_id only, verified actor; QUEUED/RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/STOP/INTERRUPTED/RECOVERY_REQUIRED, FIFO two slots, actor two/global twenty, terminal event reservation, 120 seconds, two attempts, generation-token fence and sealed-output recovery.
